faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What kinds of mobile projects are covered here?
faq.a1: Marketplace offline-first platforms, enterprise sports streaming, secure banking, ecommerce modernization, and healthcare reporting systems.
faq.q2: Which technologies do you use most often?
faq.a2: React Native and Expo (Managed and Bare), TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin, Java, GraphQL, REST APIs, AWS, Firebase, Google Cloud, Jest, Appium, and React Native New Architecture (JSI, TurboModules, Fabric).
faq.q3: How do you optimize for high traffic and reliability?
faq.a3: Offline-first sync, BFF service boundaries, native module isolation, production profiling, CI/CD with EAS and GitHub Actions, and targeted performance tuning across critical flows.
faq.a4: Yes. Reach out via LinkedIn or the contact section with context, technical constraints, and delivery timeline.
faq.q5: What are your top 3 React Native tips?
faq.a5: Use memoization with intention and avoid overusing it on low-capability devices. Build native bridges as separate modules to improve implementation quality and maintainability. Use OTA updates to deliver urgent production fixes without waiting for full app-store release cycles.
faq.q6: Can you share a production bug you solved?
faq.a6: On the NFL CTV app, I discovered a memory leak where repeated play and pause taps triggered broad rerenders across the screen. I resolved it by isolating player-control state, applying targeted memoization, stabilizing callbacks, and cleaning up lingering listeners.
faq.q7: Why use React Native and Expo for enterprise mobile delivery?
faq.a7: React Native with Expo enables fast cross-platform delivery while still supporting secure native modules when product requirements demand hardware-level integrations. It helps teams reduce duplicate effort and keep release velocity high without sacrificing quality.
faq.q8: Do you require visa sponsorship or relocation support?
faq.a8: Open to employer visa sponsorship, structured relocation programs, and self-relocation under contract or relocation-as-a-service arrangements. Actively targeting senior mobile engineering roles in Canada, the USA, and Europe.
